_comment: The four MCP servers superdev speaks through, and the template /superdev:connect writes into a project's .mcp.json. They are NOT declared in plugin.json: a product identity is per-project, a plugin manifest is per-install, and a credential that belongs to one repository has no business in a file every repository shares. Replace PRODUCT_IDENTITY with the credential. apps/backend/test/mcp-agents.test.ts reads this file to check the agents address servers that exist.
